name: Cherry Tomato
description: A small, sweet tomato variety that grows in clusters. Great for salads and snacking.
tips: Provide sturdy support as they can grow quite large. Water consistently to prevent cracking.
succession: Plant every 2-3 weeks for a continuous harvest.
yield: High yield, can produce hundreds of tomatoes per plant.

soil.type: Well-drained, loamy soil rich in organic matter.
soil.notes: Benefits from added calcium to prevent blossom-end rot.

temperature.notes: A warm-season crop. Fruit will not set at temperatures consistently below 55°F or above 90°F.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

storage.notes: Store on the counter, not in the refrigerator.

Fertilize with low-nitrogen food
careTasks.description: Once fruit begins to set, feed with a fertilizer high in phosphorus and potassium.

careTasks.description: Harvest tomatoes when they are fully colored and firm.

name: Beefsteak Tomato
description: A large, meaty tomato variety, perfect for slicing.
tips: Provide strong support due to the heavy fruit. Mulch to retain moisture.
succession: Not typically needed due to long harvest period.
yield: Lower yield than other varieties, but much larger fruit.

soil.type: Well-drained, fertile soil high in organic matter.

temperature.notes: A warm-season crop. Fruit will not set at temperatures consistently below 55°F or above 90°F.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

storage.notes: Store on the counter, not in the refrigerator.

careTasks.description: Set up strong support systems early.

name: Cucamelon
description: A small, grape-sized fruit that looks like a tiny watermelon and tastes like a cucumber with a hint of lime.
tips: Grow on a trellis to save space and make harvesting easier. The roots develop tubers, so a large pot is best if container gardening.
succession: Plant every 2-3 weeks for a continuous harvest.

temperature.notes: Loves warm weather. Very frost sensitive.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week.

careTasks.name: Set up trellis
careTasks.description: Install a trellis at planting time.

careTasks.name: Fertilize
careTasks.description: Fertilize with a high-potassium liquid fertilizer to encourage fruiting.
